name: Danyang SYNGEN Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Danyang SYNGEN Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. operates across a diverse range of fields, including the cultivation of horticultural products (flower seedlings), the provision of landscaping solutions, ecological restoration, and the development of facilities for tourism, cultural activities, and sports. The company provides comprehensive services, from initial design to project implementation and related support, for various urban, tourism, and greening initiatives throughout China.
